findings.issue: Default Markdown heading IDs broke GitHub section fragments.
findings.disposition: Fixed with a pinned GitHub slugger and per-document heading state; both behavior profiles verified the regression.

findings.issue: Two-space roadmap child bullets rendered as sibling tickets.
findings.disposition: Fixed with two-space Markdown nesting and a structural HTML regression; both behavior profiles verified the correction.

findings.issue: A final rename failure can remove regenerable local build output.
findings.disposition: Accepted local-build limitation owned by build maintainers: rerun generation after filesystem failure; atomic local output replacement is deferred. Source files and the deployed site remain protected.
